title: About the Audience
use_cases: Use when defining target audience personas for web fiction marketing
Configure when selecting a publishing platform based on gender demographics
Implement when tailoring narrative tropes for progression fantasy or LitRPG readers
content:
Web novels are most popular among readers who love to dive into stories right from their phones and enjoy experiencing the plot as it unfolds. There are lots of enthusiastic communities around genres like romance, progression fantasy, LitRPG, and fanfiction, where fans love to theorize and support their favorite creators.

Readers are mostly between the ages of 18 and 35. Platforms like Wattpad and Webnovel have a slightly higher female audience, with Wattpad seeing around 56% of its audience being female. On the other hand, Royal Road tends to attract more male readers. Young adults and millennials are at the heart of web fiction’s growing popularity, exploring different genres, but the geographic appeal is diverse, including the United States, East Asia, and other global regions.
